parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter plan instances that have remaining site quota. Valid values:

true: Filters plan instances that have remaining site quota.
false: Queries all plan instances under the user
parameters.help_zh:
是否筛选有剩余站点配额的套餐实例。支持：

true：筛选有剩余站点配额的套餐实例。
false：查询用户下所有的套餐实例
parameters.name: check_remaining_site_quota

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
online: Normal service status.
offline: Expired but not overdue, in an inactive state.
disable: Released.
overdue: Overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
套餐实例状态。支持：
online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态。
overdue：欠费状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

CreateTime: Purchase time.
ExpireTime: Expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照新购时间排序。支持：

CreateTime：新购时间。
ExpireTime：到期时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

asc: Ascending order.
desc: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序标识，默认为降序。支持：

asc：升序。
desc：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number settings for paging. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。默认值为1。取值范围为：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The plan instance ID. You can obtain this value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 套餐实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Queries plan instances whose remaining validity period is within the specified number of days. The value must be a positive integer. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 查询套餐有效期剩余天数在指定天数以内的套餐实例，只能为正整数，单位为天
parameters.name: remaining_expire_days

parameters.help_en:
The plan subscription type. Valid values:

Free Edition (Chinese mainland): entranceplan
Free Edition (International): entranceplan_intl
Basic Edition: basicplan
Standard Edition: standardplan
Premium Edition: advancedplan
Enterprise Edition: enterpriseplan
parameters.help_zh:
套餐订阅类型。取值范围：

免费版（国内）：entranceplan
免费版（国际）：entranceplan_intl
基础版：basicplan
标准版：standardplan
高级版：advancedplan
企业版：enterpriseplan
parameters.name: subscribe_type

parameters.help_en:
The plan type. Valid values:

normal: fixed edition plan
enterprise: enterprise edition plan
parameters.help_zh:
套餐类型。取值范围:

normal: 固定版套餐
enterprise: 企业版套餐
parameters.name: plan_type

InstanceInfo.description_en: The plan instances that match the specified conditions under the user
InstanceInfo.description_zh: 查询到的该用户下符合条件的套餐实例

items.description_en: The details of the plan instance

BillingMode.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

PREPAY: Subscription.
POSTPAY: Pay-as-you-go
BillingMode.description_zh:
付费类型。支持：

PREPAY：预付费。
POSTPAY：后付费

BotInstanceLevel.description_en:
If empty, the plan does not include a bot protection instance. If a value is returned, the plan includes a bot protection instance. Valid values:

enterprise_bot: Web edition.

enterprise_bot_with_app: App edition
BotInstanceLevel.description_zh:
为空时，套餐未购买BOT防护实例；
返回值时，套餐购买BOT防护实例，取值：

enterprise_bot web版

enterprise_bot_with_app APP版

BotRequest.description_en: The prepaid bot protection requests included in the plan (in units of 10,000)
BotRequest.description_zh: 套餐中已预支付的 BOT 请求数（万次）

Coverages.description_en:
The acceleration coverage areas for sites that can be bound to this plan instance. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

domestic: China or the Chinese mainland.
overseas: Global (excluding China or the Chinese mainland).
global: Global (including China or the Chinese mainland)
Coverages.description_zh:
该站点可绑定的站点的加速区域范围，多个用（,）隔开。取值：

domestic：中国或中国内地。
overseas：全球（不包含中国或中国内地）。
global：全球（包含中国或中国内地）

CreateTime.description_en: The purchase time of the plan instance. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 套餐实例的新购时间，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
